title: InstantSearchNext default routing drops search query param from URL upon hydration

comments.body: Do you have a search box in that page? The base sandbox can be based on https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/tree/master/examples/react/next-app-router, so you can use that to reproduce

Thanks for the sandbox link - I'm currently trying to reproduce the behavior and it seems its a bit more complex than initially described. I'll reopen a new issue with a working sandbox sample at a later date.
For the time being the initially described workaround might be useful for anyone who stumbles upon this issue.
